return $input.all().map((item, index) => {
  const json = { ...(item.json || {}) };
  const isMetal = json.product_type === 'metal wall art' || json.product_type === 'metal revizyon';
  const promptIndex = Number(json.prompt_index);
  const replacement = PROMPTS[promptIndex];
  const sceneSize = SCENE_SIZES[promptIndex];
  const masterUrlText = String(masterUrl);
  const useHostedMaster = isMetal && !isPrinted && (masterUrlText.startsWith('https://') || masterUrlText.startsWith('http://'));
  if (isMetal && !isPrinted) {
    if (replacement) json.prompts = replacement;
    if (sceneSize) {
      json.size = sceneSize;
      json.explicit_scene_size = true;
    }
  }
  if (useHostedMaster) {
    json.fal_source_url = String(masterUrl);
    json.fal_source_kind = 'unprinted_metal_master';
  }
  return {
    json,
    ...(useHostedMaster ? {} : { binary: item.binary }),
    pairedItem: item.pairedItem || { item: index }
  };
});

const NEGATIVE_PROMPTS = {
  13: "changed product geometry, redrawn design, simplified design, closed slit, filled opening, missing cutout, extra bridge, thickened line, warped circle, crop, duplicate product, thick slab, bevel, embossed relief, gray face, silver face, glossy paint, coarse pebble texture, leather texture, spotlight, light pool, vignette, wall stripes, masonry courses, green cast, yellow cast, hard shadow, doubled shadow, mounting pin, screw, spacer, backing plate, added frame, furniture, decor, text, watermark"
};
const PARSE_FALLBACK = new Set([1]);
const HIGH_FILL = new Set([2, 12, 13, 15]);
const SCENE_OVERRIDES = {
  13: { size: '2048x2048', explicit_scene_size: true }
};
const SEED_OFFSETS = { 12: 400000000, 15: 500000000 };

let parsedItems = [];
try { parsedItems = $('Parse_JSON').all(); } catch (e) {}
const originalPrompts = new Map();
for (const source of parsedItems) {
  const sourceJson = source.json || {};
  const key = String(sourceJson.product_type || '') + '|' + Number(sourceJson.prompt_index);
  if (typeof sourceJson.prompts === 'string' && sourceJson.prompts.trim()) {
    originalPrompts.set(key, sourceJson.prompts);
  }
}

let highFillUrl = '';
try { highFillUrl = $('Metal_Master_URL_Metadata').first()?.json?.metal_master_highfill_url || ''; } catch (e) {}

return $input.all().map((item, index) => {
  const json = { ...(item.json || {}) };
  const promptIndex = Number(json.prompt_index);
  const isMetal = json.product_type === 'metal wall art' || json.product_type === 'metal revizyon';
  if (isMetal && !isPrinted) {
    const replacement = PROMPTS[promptIndex];
    if (replacement) {
      json.prompts = replacement;
    } else if (PARSE_FALLBACK.has(promptIndex)) {
      const key = String(json.product_type || '') + '|' + promptIndex;
      const originalPrompt = originalPrompts.get(key);
      if (!originalPrompt) {
        throw new Error('Missing Parse_JSON fallback for r36 scene M' + String(promptIndex).padStart(2, '0'));
      }
      json.prompts = originalPrompt;
    }

    const negativePrompt = NEGATIVE_PROMPTS[promptIndex];
    if (negativePrompt) json.fal_negative_prompt = negativePrompt;

    const sceneOverride = SCENE_OVERRIDES[promptIndex];
    if (sceneOverride) {
      json.size = sceneOverride.size;
      json.explicit_scene_size = sceneOverride.explicit_scene_size;
    }

    if (HIGH_FILL.has(promptIndex)) {
      const url = String(highFillUrl);
      if (!(url.startsWith('https://') || url.startsWith('http://'))) {
        throw new Error('Missing r36 high-fill physical master for scene M' + String(promptIndex).padStart(2, '0'));
      }
      json.fal_source_url = url;
      json.fal_source_kind = 'unprinted_metal_master';
      json.fal_master_fill = '0.86';
    }
    if (SEED_OFFSETS[promptIndex]) json.fal_seed_offset = SEED_OFFSETS[promptIndex];
  }
  return {
    json,
    ...(item.binary ? { binary: item.binary } : {}),
    pairedItem: item.pairedItem || { item: index }
  };
});
